subject.title: [Bug]: Runtime tool surface returns blank body after gateway-touching operations; container restart only briefly clears it

question: Should maintainers treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99524 as the candidate fix to live-test for this issue, or first isolate a separate gateway/session lifecycle root cause from the reported wedged sessions?
rationale: The evidence shows a real current-release blank tool-surface regression, but the open PR covers only one prompt-projection mechanism while newer comments point at gateway restart deferral and compaction/session lifecycle behavior.

options.title: Live-test the partial candidate first
options.body: Ask affected reporters to test the current beta or PR patch and compare raw gateway logs before queuing any new fix work.

options.title: Start a separate root-cause investigation
options.body: Assign a maintainer to inspect the reported session IDs and logs before deciding whether the prompt-projection patch is related.

options.title: Design a recovery surface
options.body: Treat sessions reset or tools_status as a new recovery feature after the underlying blank-result cause is bounded.

recommendation.title: Live-test the partial candidate first
recommendation.body: Ask affected reporters to test the current beta or PR patch and compare raw gateway logs before queuing any new fix work.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue spans gateway/session lifecycle and adjacent tool-result behavior, where recent history shows steipete involved across several relevant current-main paths.
